messages.text:
Reviewed both documents; no blocking TrackTech issue. Pixel integration, independent strip packages, ODD-guided sequencing and material ownership are sound.

Suggested refinements:

1. Include operating/radiation state, temperature and rate assumptions in S0 so response, power and cooling scenarios are consistent.
2. Allow TRK-CONTROL to start from a provisional contract while numerical performance criteria remain under review.
3. Explicitly compare reserved and occupied service-route cross-sections at tracker/common-system handoffs.

Read-only review; no files changed.

limitations: Only userMessage and agentMessage text retained; reasoning, tool arguments/results and private state excluded.
Conservative path, credential, email and URL redaction is not a privacy guarantee; review retained text.
Exposed operation counts are per retained turn; journal counts can describe the same invocations and must not be added.
